items.title: Age of Skorpa
items.blurb:
Age of Skorpa
Welcome!
Get ready to step into a dark and perilous world. Age of Skorpa is a strategic board game that combines smooth card-drafting mechanics (inspired by 7 Wonders) with pure intensity, loot hunting, and classic action RPG character customization (Diablo style).

Here, you do not just build passive structures; you equip your hero from scratch, gather legendary items, optimize your inventory slots, and outsmart your rivals through intelligent tactical choices.

Core Pillars of the Game
Hero Classes and Dedicated Inventory: At the start of the game, you choose your class Each hero features slots for a Helmet, Armor, Weapon, and Rings/Amulets, turning every session into an authentic RPG experience.

Loot System and Tactical Choices: Item cards represent rare gear acquired through drafting. For each card received, you can place it directly into the appropriate slot on your board to gain stat bonuses and passive effects.


Legendary Set Synergies: Collect complete sets of armors or weapons to trigger massive multipliers for victory points.

Game Experience
Strategy and market   elements.

items.title: Aether Summon
items.blurb:
Aether Summon is a turn-based digital Trading Card Game (TCG) where players battle against each other summoning scrolls to materialize creatures and spells, powered by fluxes that channel the magical aether currents that permeate Alastria. It has been in development for the past 5 years to create a new type of TCG where randomness is removed - there's no drawing phase, no shuffling of decks - the sheer amount of possibilities, imperfect information and draft modes is all that is needed to keep the games fresh between them.

This campaign is not for the creation of the game instead it is to fund its release as Open Source software, under AGPL. 

What you'll fund is the open sourcing of a server side application that is expandable, the browser-based client, infrastructure defined as code ready for deployment in AWS, the  initial scroll collection including art & assets and a full test-suite for the engine, including for every individual card. In other words, the full code repository for a browser based game that is ready to be played in desktop, mobile or tablet, over the web, with a fully responsive front-end client. In the process you'll make it available to everyone in the world.
